# Experiment register

The schema is in `science-ultrapowers:recording-findings`. Register a run before it starts; a test split, where the project has one, is used only in a pre-registered final evaluation. Status is `planned`, `registered`, `running`, `completed`, `failed` or `aborted` (with the reason).

| Experiment id | Protocol | Hypothesis | Code / config | Seeds / splits (where applicable) | Environment | Status | Outputs | Deviations | Findings |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
